setup.title: Neural Network Pruning for Edge Deployment: A Systematic Study
setup.problem_statement: This study investigates structured pruning techniques for deploying transformer-based models on resource-constrained edge devices. We examine pruning ratios, accuracy-latency tradeoffs, and propose a novel calibration-aware pruning pipeline that maintains 94% of baseline accuracy at 40% model size reduction.
